instruction: A clean, minimalist lifestyle photograph in a medium shot captures two women in a bright, beige-walled office. On the left, the woman with a brown bob (R1) stands in profile wearing a beige blazer and grey skirt. On the right, the woman with a blonde ponytail (R2) stands facing her, wearing a light blue tied shirt and beige skirt. They stand on opposite sides of a long white desk, clasping right hands in a professional handshake. The desk holds a laptop, papers, and a white spherical lamp. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused indoor light, creating a warm, neutral color palette with clean lines and a calm, professional atmosphere.
